item.title: Mortgage Refinance Rates: The Surprising 2026 Shift
item.description:
Here’s a number that stopped homeowners in their tracks this spring: mortgage refinance demand dropped 18% in a single stretch as rates climbed to their highest level since August. Then, almost as quickly, the story flipped.

By the end of June 2026, the 30-year mortgage rate had fallen to its lowest point since May. If you own a home and have been waiting on the sidelines, the ground just moved under your feet.

item.title: Tax Return Refunds: Surprising June Payouts Explained
item.description:
Did you know millions of Americans are still receiving tax return refunds in June — nearly two months after the April filing deadline? If your refund hasn’t arrived yet, you’re not alone, and the reason might surprise you.

This year’s tax return cycle has been one of the most talked-about in recent memory, from smaller-than-expected refunds to high-profile legal battles involving the IRS itself. Here’s what you need to know right now.
